content.short: Mozaic provides AI-Optimized yield and liquidity strategies.
content.description: Mozaic aims to lower the entry barrier to DeFi by offering AI-powered, automated yield farming. The platform runs yield farming tasks through artificial intelligence and LayerZero connectivity, trimming the technical burden while seeking to maximize returns. As a community-founded project launched by a small team, Mozaic pursues a mission of putting practical AI tools into the hands of everyday users, making advanced strategies accessible to non-experts.
